contract.limits: Text/cache presence and object counts do not establish semantic equivalence, workbook correctness, animation behavior, or visual quality

review_evidence: Host-recorded observations bound to current file/images; the CLI cannot prove an image was actually viewed

visual_review.summary: Viewed the rendered cover: complete English and Chinese glyphs, clear hierarchy, restrained color and no clipped text. 封面中英文完整，层级清楚，无裁切。

Viewed final render: chart values 12, 18, 25, 31 and Q1–Q4 match the synthetic source; baseline is zero, 31 has label headroom, ¥ million unit and illustrative-data footer are visible. 图表数据、单位和示例标注可见，标签无裁切。
Viewed final render: bilingual table headers and four rows are complete and now fit without orphan characters; footer is separate and readable. 表格四行及表头完整，中英文无孤字换行，页脚清晰。

All three current exported pages inspected. Color/type/grid are consistent; cover, native chart and table have distinct purposes. Native chart/table verified structurally; sample data and font limitations documented. 三页顺序与设计一致，已核对原生对象；已声明示例数据及字体边界。

limitations: Rendered with LibreOffice on macOS; Microsoft PowerPoint itself was not tested. Automated checks do not prove aesthetic quality.
